name: The Devoted Circle
description: Build a circle of 5 devoted agents. Establish universal devotion.

conditions.description: At least 2 worshippers at tier 2 (Demigod) or higher
At least 3 worshippers at tier 3 (Divine) or higher

stages.description: Elevate 5 agents to Divine tier (tier 3). Your circle is complete.

conditions.description: At least 5 worshippers at tier 3 (Divine) or higher

prose.setup_to_escalation: Two servants rise to demigod status. The circle begins to form. Devotion takes shape in flesh and purpose.
prose.escalation_to_culmination: Three of your disciples now stand as divine beings. The circle grows. Their devotion has become a force that bends reality.
prose.completed: Five divine servants stand around your throne. The Devoted Circle is complete. Their collective will becomes indistinguishable from your own.
prose.failed: The circle fractures before it forms. Your disciples resist ascension. Perhaps devotion cannot be cultivated by decree alone.
